title: Fix ArgoCD deploying Never image pull policy to production
description: k8s/kustomization.yaml was added to the base k8s directory for Skaffold, but ArgoCD auto-detected it and applied the 'Never' imagePullPolicy patch to production LKE cluster, causing ErrImageNeverPull. We will restructure the manifests by removing the base kustomization.yaml, putting the dev-specific overrides under k8s/dev/kustomization.yaml, and updating skaffold.yaml to point to k8s/dev.

title: Fix SVG needle rotation decimal separator localization bug
description: The compass view rendering is broken under locales that use a comma as the decimal separator, causing the rotation angle to format as '284,21' instead of '284.21'. In SVG, 'rotate(284,21, 50, 50)' is parsed by browsers as having four parameters, leading to syntax errors and a broken needle. The fix is to format the SVG string using a locale-independent formatter (locale:nil) in CompassSVGGenerator.m.

title: Verify local asset delivery via browser network tab
description: Using browser developer tools (Network tab), verify that the Leaflet JS and CSS assets are being served from the local application server (/WebServerResources/vendor/leaflet/) and NOT from an external CDN.

title: Final quality gates and user sign-off for Map component
description: Perform final verification of the map component. Ensure all XCTest and Jest tests pass, visual integration is confirmed, and asset delivery is local. Obtain user sign-off on the implementation.

title: Integrate ObservationMap into a test page for visual verification
description: Integrate the ObservationMap component into a test page or an existing flow (e.g., Capture summary). Verify visually that: 1) The map renders correctly when coords exist, and 2) The 'No location captured' message appears when they do not.

title: Write Jest tests for ObservationMap.js (mocking Leaflet)
description: Create Jest tests for ObservationMap.js. Mock the Leaflet global object to verify that L.map() and L.marker() are called with the correct coordinates extracted from the DOM elements' data attributes.

title: Write XCTest cases to validate ObservationMap coordinate logic
description: Create XCTest cases in the test/ directory to verify ObservationMap. Specifically, test that 'hasValidCoordinates' returns correct values for: 1) Both lat and lng present, 2) Only one present, 3) Neither present. Verify coordinate extraction logic is accurate.

title: Create WebServerResources/ObservationMap.js for map initialization
description: Create WebServerResources/ObservationMap.js. This script should find map containers in the DOM, read their data-lat and data-lng attributes, and initialize a Leaflet map centered at those coordinates with a single marker (pin). Use locally vendored Leaflet assets.

title: Create ObservationMap.wo/ObservationMap.html with WOConditional logic
description: Create ObservationMap.wo/ObservationMap.html. Use WOConditional to only render the map container and local Leaflet assets if an ObservationLocation has valid coordinates. If not, show a WOString with 'No location captured'. The map container should have data attributes (data-lat, data-lng) populated by the component.

title: Implement server-side coord extraction and hasValidCoordinates in ObservationMap.m
description: In ObservationMap.m, implement: 1) A method 'hasValidCoordinates' that returns YES if both latitude and longitude are set on the associated ObservationLocation object. 2) Logic to extract these values as strings/numbers for use in the HTML template data attributes.
